Dear ImGui vendored at v1.92.2b (MIT). The project was originally built against
the 1.93.0 WIP head; 1.93.0 was never tagged, and 1.92.2b is the closest tagged
release with the same API (style.FontScaleMain present). If a native rebuild hits
an API mismatch, bump to the latest 1.9x from https://github.com/ocornut/imgui .
